Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.progression

Class AchievementTracker

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.progression.AchievementTracker
public class AchievementTracker extends Object
Notices achievements earned during one run. Most are checked from the game state once per turn by check(GameSession); a few depend on a moment in time and are reported directly with unlock(GameSession, Achievement).

Earning an achievement never changes the game state (it only adds a message), so it does not affect replays.
